_comment: Effect catalog (real data; the schema is whatever this file says it is). Effects are pure capability records describing what an effect *is* as state on its bearer: identity (id/name/description), default duration, and state-side params (the ongoing magnitude or rules — e.g. ac_bonus, damage_per_turn, regen amount). WHO can have an effect and HOW it gets applied live on the granter (Character Class.abilities, Race.traits, Item.grants_effect, Spell.action_params for spell-applied statuses, Monster.passives/on_hit_effects). Application-time params (save_dc, max_target_hp, etc.) live on those applier records. See docs/data_dictionary/effect.md.

effects.name: Detect Traps
effects.description: Traps are revealed before the party steps on them.

effects.name: Infravision
effects.description: Pierces darkness, revealing the world in shades of red.

effects.name: Shielded
effects.description: A faint magical barrier improves the recipient's armor.

effects.name: Asleep
effects.description: Lulled into a magical slumber; cannot act until shaken loose or the spell fades.

effects.name: Long Shanks
effects.description: The recipient's stride is magically lengthened, extending movement range.

effects.name: Invisible
effects.description: Cannot be seen or targeted directly until the magic fades or the bearer attacks.

effects.name: Charmed
effects.description: Loyalty is magically redirected toward the source for the duration.

effects.name: Light
effects.description: A soft magical glow illuminates the area around the bearer.

effects.name: Blessed
effects.description: Divine favor grants a bonus to attack rolls.

effects.name: Cursed
effects.description: A magical curse weakens the target's defense and accuracy.

effects.name: Repelled
effects.description: Nearby monsters are pushed back from the bearer each turn.

effects.name: Drained
effects.description: Life force is transferred from the target to the attacker on a successful hit.

effects.name: Poisoned
effects.description: A toxin courses through the target, dealing damage each turn until it wears off.

effects.name: Slowed
effects.description: Reactions are sluggish; effective movement is reduced.

effects.name: Consumed
effects.description: Swallowed whole; the target takes damage each turn until they break free.

effects.name: Fire Resistance
effects.description: Halves damage from fire-based spells and attacks.

effects.name: Poison Immunity
effects.description: Immune to poison damage and the Poisoned status.
